capabilities: Record incoming WeChat messages into daily conversation notes
Decrypt received media into an attachments folder and embed it in notes
Fetch linked articles in full as markdown notes grouped by official account
Send files dropped into an outbox folder as WeChat text messages or attachments
Maintain an Agent.md protocol file so AI agents can send notifications
extras: Desktop-only (mobile not supported). The gateway throttles proactive sends (a notification channel, not a chat tool), cannot receive forwarded articles/files, keeps offline messages for an undocumented period, and supports only one device per account. Listing is not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: WeChat conversations are trapped in the app — unsearchable, unlinkable, and lost when switching phones — so they never make it into your knowledge base.

relations.evidence: bridges WeChat and your vault through Tencent's official ilink bot gateway

summary: WeChat bridge that writes incoming messages, media, and articles into vault notes and sends outbox files as WeChat messages via Tencent's ilink bot gateway.
